description: Explore your latest Kiuwo mind maps, open and interact with them directly inside ChatGPT, generate rich new mind maps from your ideas, and refine existing ones in seconds. Your private maps stay protected, saved in your Kiuwo account, and always accessible for review, editing, and continued learning — helping you organize thoughts, study faster, and transform complex information into clear, connected knowledge.
